name: Alexander
description: Son of Philip the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, smote Darius king of the Persians and Medes, reigned first over Greece twelve years, and at his death parted his kingdom among his servants

points: And it happened, after that Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead, the first over Greece: because he perceived that that was him.

note.label: Making the Great Red Dragon's 8th Head 'great Again'

points: Alexander son of Philip the Macedonian smote Darius king of the Persians and Medes, reigned over Greece, made many wars, and took spoils of many nations; then he fell sick, perceived that he should die, and parted his kingdom among his servants.

note.label: In Vain Do They Worship Me! Religious Syncretism

points: Alexander, son of Philip the Macedonian, came out of Chittim and smote Darius the Persian: the Greeks began to conquer the dark nations, which is Edom rebuilding the desolate places.

note.label: Edom: The Robbers of thy people revealed past and present

points: Alexander, son of Philip the Macedonian, came out of Chittim, smote Darius, and reigned first over Greece. Philip was an Edomite, so these Macedonians were not of Japheth.
Alexander was the first king over Greece. He was the first Edomite king that had unified and rallied all together.

Who were the Greeks? From the time of Philip and Alexander. “Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian”, who “had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes”, “reigned in his stead, the first over Greece”: Alexander the Greek became the first.

note.label: Palestine And The Man Of Sin

points: “Alexander son of Philip, the Macedonian, who came out of the land of Chettiim, had smitten Darius king of the Persians and Medes, that he reigned in his stead”: he took over Persia. The Persians were not Israelites, but they were dark-skinned people. How are you going to claim their antiquity when that is not you? That is how sick these people are.

“The first over Greece”: Alexander was the first king. That is what the brothers showed him in the eighth chapter of Daniel when they met him in the field, and he said, that must be me: I am getting ready to fulfill prophecy.

note.label: THE CURTAINS OF CONTROL BEHIND TRUMP’S DESK

points: Alexander “came out of the land of Chettiim”, and Chettiim is Italy. Write it down: when the Bishops and Deacons mention these little points, you write them down and go home and keep studying. This is Alexander the Great, who killed Darius III and “reigned in his stead, the first over Greece”.

note.label: The War Between Blacks And Whites

points: Alexander slew the kings of the earth. What did Isaac tell Esau? By thy sword thou shalt live; they should dwell in the fatness of the earth, the best places, and they should cover the earth as the dew.

“And made many wars, and won many strong holds, and slew the kings of the earth”: because of his pride, because he knew he was satanic on earth. When Antiochus came up he said I am the power of God on earth, and that came right out of Alexander. That is their pragmatic, sociopathic thinking: slay everybody, the hell with your babies. Look at the slaughter when they went to Santo Domingo, the island of Hispaniola, hacking our brothers and sisters to pieces, hanging them up and burning them alive, throttling their throats so they could not scream, and loving it. That is the kind of snakes you are dealing with.

note.label: THE CURTAINS OF CONTROL BEHIND TRUMP’S DESK

points: “And parted his kingdom among them, while he was yet alive”: he divided his kingdom among his four generals, Lysimachus, Ptolemy, Cassander and Seleucus. They set up the same government over all the nations, so the same lies taught here are taught everywhere, according to the edict Alexander set up from what he read in the books he had his people collect from everywhere.

note.label: THE CURTAINS OF CONTROL BEHIND TRUMP’S DESK

points: Alexander the Great ruled 12 years and then died. He had four major generals.

So Alexander reigned twelve years, and then died. And his servants bare rule every one in his place: so they all teach each other. They pass that information all the way down, from the Greeks to the Romans to the Spanish, the French, the Germans, the Russians, and the British. All those records come all the way down to the end on how to keep Israel subdued.
